title: Oase 1, early modern human from Peștera cu Oase, Romania
summary: Oase 1 is a lower jaw found in 2002 in Peștera cu Oase, western Romania, from a modern human dated to 37,000–42,000 years ago. Genome-wide data showed that on the order of six to nine percent of its genome derived from Neanderthals, pointing to a Neanderthal ancestor as recently as four to six generations back.

uncertainty.note: Source range is 37,000–42,000 years old; converted roughly as 1950 minus age (-40050 to -35050). The sources give no zero point, so the conversion is approximate.

as_recorded.value: dated between 37,000 and 42,000 years old; jaw found in 2002

where.historical_name: Peștera cu Oase, Romania; no polity at this date

importance.justification: An early modern European whose genome shows recent Neanderthal ancestry.
